title: Decrease Elements To Make Array Zigzag
summary: Given an array of integers, a move involves reducing any element by one.
statement: Given an array of integers, a move involves reducing any element by one. An array is considered zigzag if each even-indexed element is greater than its neighbors or each odd-indexed element is greater than its neighbors. Determine the least number of moves needed to convert the provided array into a zigzag array.
constraints: Either all even or all odd indices must be strict valleys.
hints: Evaluate the two possible valley parities independently.
A valley only needs to be lowered below its smaller neighbor.
Valleys of one parity are never adjacent, so their optimal decrements add independently.
editorial: Valleys of one parity are never adjacent, so their optimal decrements add independently.

tests.explanation: Lowering the middle below both neighbors costs two moves.
Making even indices valleys costs four moves, the minimum orientation.
